LOVE: Dil se teri yaad na jaye to kya karun, Tasveer mein tu hi nazar aaye to kya karun.
Tumhaari ek jhalak ke liye taraste hain, hum to bas tumhari mohabbat pe marte hain.
Mohabbat ki dastan sunane aaye hain, tute hue dil ko manane aaye hain.
Khuda ne tumhe bade fursat se banaya hai, meri kismat mein tujhe likh kar mujh par ehsaan jataya hai.
Teri saadgi ne humein deewana bana diya, tere ishq ne humein parwana bana diya.
Dil mein base ho tum dhadkan ki tarah, yaad aate ho tum saanson ki tarah.
Tumhari ek hansi pe duniya vaar doon, tere liye apni jaan tak haar doon.
Teri aankhon ke noor ne humein roshan kar diya, tere ishq ne humein gulshan kar diya.
Dil ka rishta kabhi tut-ta nahi, sacha pyaar kabhi chhut-ta nahi.
Raaton ki neend chura li hai tumne, dil ki chain cheen li hai tumne.
SAD: Zindagi mein gum hai, gum mein zindagi hai, par jaaneman tere bina adhuri har khushi hai.
Koshish to bahut ki par tumhe bhula na sake, dil se tumhara naam mita na sake.
Zakhme-e-dil ko chhupana seekh liya, dard mein bhi muskurana seekh liya.
Tanhaayi mein aksar tujhe yaad karte hain, teri tasveer se ghanto baat karte hain.
Dard ka ehsas tab hota hai jab koi apna door ho jaye, dil tab tut-ta hai jab koi bharosa tod jaye.
Yaadon ka silsila rukta nahi, ishq ka dariya kabhi sukhta nahi.
Wafa ki umeed ab kis se karein, yahan to log apna keh kar hi badal jaate hain.
Khamosh chehre par hazaron pehre hote hain, aankhon mein zakhm bade gehre hote hain.
Bhulana seekho use jo tumhe bhool gaya ho, kyunki ishq mein bewafai ka koi ilaaj nahi hota.
Har lamha teri yaad aati hai, dil ko bahut satati hai.
DOSTI: Dosti ka rishta sabse pyara hai, tu hi meri jeet ka sahara hai.
Teri dosti mere liye sabse badi nemat hai, tu hi meri asli daulat hai.
Teri dosti mere liye ek uphar hai, teri har baat mere liye ek yaadgaar hai.
Dosti ka haath kabhi mat chhodna, kyunki dost hi hote hain jo har dard mein saath dete hain.
Sacha dost wahi hai jo dukh mein saath de, aur khushi mein sabse pehle mubarakbaad de.
Zindagi ke safar mein tera saath chahiye, har mod par tera haath chahiye.
Dosti mein dhokha kabhi mat dena, kyunki dosti se bada koi rishta nahi hota.
Khuda ne tujhe mere liye hi banaya hai, teri dosti ne mujhe jeena sikhaya hai.
Zindagi ki raahon mein dard milta hai, par teri dosti mein sukoon milta hai.
Dosti ka rishta kabhi mat todna, kyunki dost hi hote hain jo har dard mein saath dete hain.
RANDOM: Ishq ne hamein nikamma kar diya Ghalib, varna hum bhi aadmi the kaam ke.
Khuda se kya maangu tere vaaste, bas dua hai ki tu kabhi dard na paaye.
Har ek muskurahat muskaan nahi hoti, nafrat ho ya mohabbat har ek insaan nahi hoti.
Yaadon ki dhoop mein hum aksar jalte hain, tere intezar mein din raat nikalte hain.
Dil ki galiyon mein tumhara hi basera hai, meri har subah mein tera hi chehra hai.
Waqt bit jayega par yaadein reh jayengi, teri baatein hamesha dil mein ghar kar jayengi.
Khwabon mein aakar humein sataaya na karo, yun baar-baar dil ko dhadkaaya na karo.
Ishq ka nasha sar chadh kar bolta hai, har lamha bas tera hi naam bolta hai.
Duniya ki parwah nahi humein, bas teri ek nazar hi kaafi hai.
Zindagi ek safar hai suhana, yahan kal kya ho kisne jaana.
